subQuests.subQuestName: Give the Wonder Cores and Adepti Sigils to the secretary.

110150101.text: Ningguang's little secretary! We've found all the materials!

110150103.text: All three of you found them together? Okay, I see.

110150104.text: The Wonder Cores and Adepti Sigils look good. It seems that we've found our winners.

110150105.text: #I hereby announce that the winners of this material procurement contest are {NICKNAME}, Yun Jin, and Beidou!

110150106.text: What? It's over already? I haven't even found the Plaustrite yet!

110150109.text: I'd like to invite our three winners to please proceed to the Jade Chamber, where Lady Ningguang is waiting for you.

110150110.text: Huh? Where's Beidou? She was right here.

110150111.text: Captain Beidou has some business to attend to. She will join later. Please come with me for now.

110150112.text: Alright then, guess we'll head on up to the Jade Chamber first.

110150113.text: This has been a long time coming! The last time we went up to the Jade Chamber was aaaages ago!

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Ningguang at the Jade Chamber

110150201.text: Combine the Adepti Sigils with the Wonder Cores and insert them into the Jade Chamber's control compartment.

110150202.text: The construction of the new Jade Chamber is now officially complete. Once the tethers are released, it will soar into the sky.

110150203.text: Thank you all for your work. Now it is time for me to fulfill my promise.

110150205.text: Ms. Yun, I've already heard something about the reason for your involvement. You are looking for a venue for your new opera, aren't you?

110150206.text: That's right. Lady Ningguang, I would like to hear your opinion.

110150207.text: The unveiling of Ms. Yun's grand new opera surely requires a venue of equal grandeur. So what would you say if I proposed that we stage your first performance right here, in the newly built Jade Chamber?

110150208.text: The Jade Chamber offers a splendid panoramic view of the mountains and the bustling city. It is fitting for the finest performance to be hosted in the heavens... I can think of no better stage for you than here, Ms. Yun.

110150209.text: Thank you, Lady Ningguang. Then I will prepare my props and other articles shortly. Please allow me to bring all these aboard the Jade Chamber.

110150210.text: You're quite welcome. It's truly what a good opera deserves.

110150211.text: #{NICKNAME}, Shenhe, Paimon, I'll be leaving now. Do come and see my play when the time comes.

110150213.text: #I should clarify. I do not know your {F#brother's}{M#sister's} whereabouts. So please, don't waste your question on this matter.

110150214.text: Wow... You're a mind-reader, Ningguang! Oh well, guess Paimon will ask a question then!

110150215.text: ...Managing a successful business is not as simple as you might think. Capital, connections, sensitivity to the trends, an instinct for what is a good opportunity... All of these traits are crucial.

110150216.text: If you want to know how to make money, I will honor our agreement and give you an answer. But that is not to say that it will work for you.

110150217.text: Wow! Paimon hadn't even asked the question yet!

110150218.text: Your question was written all over your face. Now look, you've helped me rebuild the Jade Chamber, and I intend to repay you handsomely for it.

110150219.text: So I promise you that should you one day require financial assistance, you may seek employment here. I will pay you at the highest rate of remuneration.

110150220.text: Great! So next time we run out of Mora, we just need to come to Ningguang!

110150221.text: No more questions from us. Shenhe, you got a question?

110150223.text: Yes! This was a group effort!

110150224.text: Thank you... But I don't have anything to ask.

110150225.text: Are you sure? This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. I'd urge you not to squander it.

110150226.text: Yeah, just don't waste it! Hold on a second, Paimon can probably think of another one...

110150227.text: Lady Ningguang... do you think I can ever fit in in Liyue Harbor?

110150228.text: Now that is an interesting question.

110150229.text: Liyue Harbor is very inclusive. As long as you respect the rules here, you will not be turned away.

110150230.text: So the key is whether or not you yourself can develop a sense of belonging in Liyue Harbor.

110150232.text: Yes. To become fond of a place, to feel part of it... it always requires a reason.

110150233.text: Perhaps someone you've met or something you've experienced here. Or perhaps you enjoy the atmosphere of Liyue and you will become accustomed to it.

110150234.text: In short, everyone needs a reason to stay. I hope you can find yours soon.

110150236.text: Hey, what's going on? I just went to see the fleet, I'm a little later than expected.

110150237.text: Come on, Beidou, it's your turn! Do you have a question for Ningguang?

110150238.text: Me? Nah, I ain't got any questions. She forced me to help out, so I figured I may as well get involved with the contest.

110150239.text: Ningguang, don't forget what we talked about.

110150240.text: It's not gonna be easy to deal with. I don't think my fleet can take it on their own.

110150241.text: Don't worry, I have made preparations. The wound dressings are ready and the Millelith have set up an ambush.

110150242.text: Glad to hear it. Watch your back. Stay alert!

110150243.text: Beidou, Ningguang, what are you talking about?

110150244.text: You'll see when the Jade Chamber ascends. However... it's not the most pleasant topic of conversation. Maybe it's better that you don't know.

110150245.text: When I first set foot in the Jade Chamber, I stood at the edge of the platform and looked down upon Liyue Harbor far below.

110150246.text: At that time, I dreamed that one day the Jade Chamber's shadow would be seen in all seven nations of Teyvat.

110150247.text: My wish has not changed to this very day. However, it is not only out of consideration for myself that I have built the Jade Chamber anew at this time.

110150248.text: I hope the Jade Chamber will always float in the skies above Liyue Harbor, bearing witness to the prosperity and peace of the human world...

110150249.text: ...and I hope that you can all witness it with me.

110150702.text: After our trip to Mt. Tianheng together, I felt much more in touch with the character today. I believe I was able to deliver a more profound performance because of it.

110150703.text: Next time I have a new opera, may we study the character together again?

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat Beisht, "The Avenger of the Vortex"
Defeat Beisht, "The Avenger of the Vortex"

110150801.text: The Millelith's casualties are within the range we expected.

110150802.text: But in hindsight, there were still flaws with our plan.

110150803.text: If we'd had more time, we could have built a barrier here to absorb the impact of the waves.

110150804.text: We must learn from this experience and never repeat the same mistakes again... We were fortunate to have your assistance this time. Thank you.

110150304.text: I'm just a little exhausted. Otherwise, fine.

110150305.text: I wanted to deal with it myself. I didn't expect you to follow me.

110150306.text: Don't worry. She's not coming back any time soon. After an injury like that, she'll likely seek refuge somewhere else.

110150308.text: It's been dealt with. She was injured before entering the water. It didn't take too much effort to finish the job.

110150309.text: Good. So the crisis has been safely averted. When you visit the Jade Chamber in the future, you will be afforded generous treatment.

110150310.text: Lady Ningguang, the fleet reports that the sea monster has left Guyun Stone Forest and the surrounding waters have returned to normal!

110150311.text: Thank you. How are the Millelith?

110150312.text: Thanks to the medical supplies you prepared and Lady Keqing's command, our losses were minimal.

110150313.text: Of course, we owe huge thanks to this young lady for her help.

110150314.text: On behalf of the entire Millelith, thank you for your service.

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the Jade Chamber to take part in the victory feast

110150402.text: It's Paimon's first time attending a banquet in the Jade Chamber! The food here looks amazing!

110150403.text: All of you here are my distinguished guests. I am determined that each of you thoroughly enjoys yourself.

110150404.text: Those who don't drink alcohol, please help yourself to other beverages. Fine wine is a delight to the senses, but it is far from the only one. I trust you will find the marvelous view from the Jade Chamber to be an equally gratifying indulgence.

110150405.text: Have you heard? Ms. Yun's going to be performing today.

110150406.text: Sure have, honestly, it's the main reason I'm here! I've never missed any of Ms. Yun's performances and I don't intend to start now.

110150407.text: I hear she's going to perform "The Divine Damsel of Devastation" today, the one written by her father. I've been so excited that I've barely slept the last few nights.

110150408.text: Hey, look, Ms. Yun is going on stage!

110150409.text: What did you think? Personally, I thought I sang rather well.

110150410.text: It was beautiful! Paimon wants to learn too!

110150411.text: It was wonderful. Also... Thank you.

110150412.text: You're welcome. Thanks to you, The Divine Damsel of Devastation is a more nuanced tale than ever.

110150413.text: The play has an ending, but life goes on. I believe you will find a way to fit in in Liyue Harbor.

110150414.text: Thank you. I think I've found the opportunity I needed to change.

110150415.text: Ms. Yun... *hic*... Here you are, great to see ya.

110150416.text: Huh? Hey, this young lady with the white hair looks like some kind of VIP. Yeah, that's it, like an adeptus.

110150417.text: #Wait, you're the girl from the opera, aren't you? The "divine damsel" herself! And look who else we have here, the illustrious {NICKNAME}! Well I'll be... this was definitely worth showing up for.

110150418.text: Lemme pull up a chair, alright? We'll all have a friendly chat, get better acquainted...

110150420.text: Alternatively, you could leave us alone. That is, if you'd prefer to finish your drink via the orifice of your own choice...

110150421.text: Uh-oh, this feels all too familiar... Shenhe's back to her old self again...

110150422.text: It seems she still has a long way to go.

110133001.text: Ah, Traveler, Paimon. I wasn't expecting to run into you out here at Guyun.

110133002.text: What brings you here? You'll have to make it quick, I'm afraid, I really can't afford to chat for too long.

110133004.text: As you can see, we're working on a construction project.

110133005.text: Personally, I consider this project to be of greater importance than the Jade Chamber rebuild. That's why I'm here to supervise.

110133006.text: I just hope we can complete it on schedule...

110133008.text: A new type of Guizhong Ballista.

110133009.text: Ningguang commissioned an expert to dismantle and study the Guizhong Ballista, and design an improved version based on the original.

110133010.text: This design is a step down from the adepti's original Guizhong Ballista in terms of firing speed and power, but the good thing about it is that it can be mass-produced.

110133011.text: It's also considerably easier to assemble and disassemble. This will allow for flexible deployment, whatever the location.

110133012.text: I'm confident it will prove very useful in dealing with future crises.

110142501.text: The fact we were able to complete the construction work on schedule is a testament to everyone's hard work.

110142601.text: The construction work on the Jade Chamber is now complete. Once we install the Wonder Cores and the Adepti Sigils, we can let it rise to altitude.

110142701.text: I don't know about anyone else, but this has been a challenging project for me... Let's get a drink after work.

110142801.text: I can't wait to see the Jade Chamber ascend!

110142901.text: Finally, we can relax a little. It's been quite stressful recently with so many people flocking here.

110142902.text: Fortunately, the construction here has gone off without a hitch. I can only hope the same is true for my comrades at Guyun Stone Forest.

110143002.text: Qiqi! What are you doing here?

110143004.text: Qiqi is helping. With the evacuation.

110143007.text: Yes. Ningguang said there's something bad in the sea.

110143008.text: So she sent Qiqi, to evacuate everyone.

110143009.text: But, no one will listen to Qiqi. So instead, Qiqi is guarding this place.

110143010.text: If danger comes, Qiqi will protect everyone.

110143011.text: Don't go near the sea. It's too dangerous.

110150501.text: Now that I think about it, I'm glad Master sent me here to deliver the sigils. Otherwise, I wouldn't have had the chance to meet you.

110150502.text: I'm sure I have much to learn from you in the future.

110150601.text: You've made an exceptional contribution toward the building of the new Jade Chamber.

110150602.text: I will not forget this. I shall be sure to repay your kindness at an appropriate juncture.

110151601.text: Drinking and watching opera in the Jade Chamber... a rare and exquisite pleasure.

110151701.text: I wonder when I'll be able to build a Jade Chamber of my own? *sigh* It'll take a lot more wealth than I have now.

110151702.text: But hey, you've gotta dream big. Who knows, if I keep working at it... Maybe one day.

110159902.text: We can't let you be the only one taking this risk!

110159903.text: I hardly see this as a great risk. The people of Liyue Harbor are well-prepared and she is already badly injured. Only sheer willpower is keeping her alive.

110159904.text: I may be nearing the end of my stamina, but in a fight to the death... I think I have the upper hand.

110159906.text: She's getting away! Shouldn't we go after her? \n

110159907.text: This place is unstable. It is too risky to continue pursuing her. \n

110159908.text: If the place collapsed, the consequences would be disastrous... Let's head back.
